title: Smoke inhalation and carbon monoxide suspicion
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for fresh-air movement, generator safety reminder, and symptom clustering records.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: headache in several people, dizziness, confusion, chest pain, soot, burns, or sleepiness near fuel device.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: headache in several people, dizziness, confusion, chest pain, soot, burns, or sleepiness near fuel device

title: Heat illness medical escalation
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for cooling actions, rest, fluids if alert, and fast escalation for heat stroke signs.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: confusion, collapse, hot skin, seizure, stopped sweating, very high temperature, or elderly alone.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: confusion, collapse, hot skin, seizure, stopped sweating, very high temperature, or elderly alone

title: Hypothermia and cold injury medical sheet
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for gentle warming, dry layers, movement limits, and slow monitoring.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: confusion, shivering stops, weak pulse, blue skin, numb hard tissue, or immersion in cold water.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: confusion, shivering stops, weak pulse, blue skin, numb hard tissue, or immersion in cold water

title: Drowning after rescue breathing watch
